target: rerun rule: PILLAR staffed by name-keyword ALGO; SMALL tags demoted to candidates
context: Completed decision-grid re-run (395 SuperInstance repos, 119 with strong-model reference labels, all cells now fully measured). Pillar tagging: the name-keyword algorithmic decider matches the strong-model reference on 65.6% exact-set (66.4% any-overlap). question: Should pillar cells be staffed by the name-keyword algorithmic decider as the production decider, with the small LLM's pillar tags demoted to unconfirmed candidates?
true: the keyword decider is the best available cheap staffing for pillar cells
false: pillar cells still require a model decider despite the measurements

target: rerun rule: keep formula-over-ALGO-cells; SUBSTANCE cell not adopted
context: Completed decision-grid re-run. Disposition dispositions (DEEP/COLLAPSE/TAIL) against 119 strong-model reference labels: a deterministic formula over the algorithmic decider's cells scores 78.2%; the same formula over perfect upstream cells caps at 80.7%. A new SUBSTANCE cell (stub vs substantive, decided by the small LLM) was added upstream: downgrading stub repos out of DEEP changed 3 cells, fixed 0, broke 1 (net 79.8%); upgrading substantive repos into DEEP fired on 21 repos of which the reference calls 0 DEEP (net for the combined rule 62.2%). The small LLM deciding disposition directly scores 43.7% — it calls DEEP far too often. The formula's residual errors are mostly substantive family members the reference rates COLLAPSE (representative, not exceptional) — a representativeness judgment, not a stub/substance one.
question: Should disposition remain a formula over the algorithmic decider's cells by default, without adopting the SUBSTANCE cell?
true: formula-by-default stands; the substance cell does not earn its place
false: the substance cell should be adopted despite not moving accuracy

target: rerun choice: TRAP's fate after the re-cut measurement

question: What should happen to the name-honesty cell(s) in the grid?

options.keep_big_watch: TRAP stays as-is: big-tier verdicts, cheap-tier flags as watches only
